widgets_values: Style: polished anime fantasy concept sheet with bright, saturated colors and clean decorative dividers. The page is arranged as a character reference board on a warm cream parchment background, with a large full-body illustration occupying the left half and structured information panels filling the right half. In the left panel, a young adult female fantasy character stands in a confident three-quarter pose, slim and petite, with fair skin, large violet eyes, soft blush, glossy lips, and a playful expression. She has dark purple-black hair styled into high twin tails with curled strands, decorated with gold chains, purple bows, cat-ear-like ornaments, and small metallic charms. Her outfit combines cute lolita fashion with gothic fantasy elements: a black and deep-purple dress with ruffled layers, a fitted bodice, lace trim, gold filigree, belts, chains, tassels, purple gemstones, thigh-high stockings, and chunky lace-up boots. Cat features appear through her ears, tail, paw-like glove details, and playful animal motifs, while bat features appear through a large dark cape shaped like wings, with pointed membranes, gold edging, and purple highlights. A small snake coils around her waist and drapes across the front of her skirt, its body patterned in black, gray, and gold, with its head raised near her hand. Around the lower-left area, two smaller turnaround drawings show the same character from side and back views, emphasizing the twin-tail silhouette, winged cape, tail, layered skirt, stockings, boots, and gold ornament placement. The top-right information card contains the title "LILITHA" in large uppercase serif lettering, followed by the subtitle "The Serpent’s Muse". Beneath it, a compact stat list reads "Role: Summoner", "Alignment: Chaotic Good", "Height: 152 cm", "Weight: 42 kg", "Birthday: May 20th", "Likes: Moonlight, sweets, music", and "Dislikes: Boredom, harsh sunlight". Below the stats, a rounded quote box displays the full sentence "I dance with the moon, and my serpent whispers ancient secrets." The middle-right panel is titled "Character Design" and shows a bust portrait of Lilitha with the same purple eyes, twin tails, ornate hair accessories, choker, lace collar, ruffled neckline, and calm, slightly teasing smile. The bottom-right panel is titled "Accessories" and presents six product-style illustrations: a purple bow hair clip with gold chains, a bat-wing pendant with a purple gem, a gold-and-purple charm bracelet, a miniature black-and-purple dress accessory, a purple gemstone ring, and a coiled snake charm or pendant. Across the entire sheet, thin brown borders, rounded rectangular frames, small diamond ornaments, dotted separators, and delicate corner flourishes unify the layout. The lighting is soft and even, with gentle shadows under the character and accessories, making the design feel like a professional game character setting sheet rather than a single scene illustration. All character introduction text uses English characters.
